name.description: The vault's name: the site's and the book's title.

language.description: The default language of the games (a code: fr, en…). Default: en.

values.description: Values written {=name} in the text: a value, or one per player count ({2p: 7, "*": 5}). See SPEC 8.6.

symbols.description: Symbols written :name: in the text: text (an emoji…), an image path, ![sym:TEXT](path), or {image, text}. See SPEC 4.

image.description: An image path (next to vault.yaml, or in the game's folder).

text.description: The text shown where images can't be (the terminal).

check.description: Defaults for tabula check (a game's frontmatter wins).

require_definitions.description: tabula check: every component needs a glossary definition.

unused_definitions.description: tabula check: warn about definitions nothing refers to (default true).
